records.name: National Insurance Academy (NIA)
records.description: National Insurance Academy (NIA) Pune, established in 1980 and promoted by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (IRDAI) and public sector insurance companies, is the apex training and research institution for India's insurance sector. It offers postgraduate programs in insurance management, executive development programs, and professional certifications for insurance industry professionals. NIA is recognized as the center of excellence for insurance education in South and Southeast Asia.

records.name: Insurance Institute of India
records.description: Insurance Institute of India (III) Mumbai, established in 1955, is a premier professional body for insurance education in India, offering fellowship and associateship examinations recognized across the insurance industry. It conducts the Licentiate, Associate, and Fellow examinations covering life insurance, general insurance, and reinsurance, which are mandatory or highly preferred qualifications for insurance professionals. III plays a central role in raising professional standards and competency across India's insurance sector.

records.name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Staff College
records.description: Reserve Bank of India Staff College Chennai is the apex training institution of the Reserve Bank of India, providing training and development programs for RBI officers across all departments. It conducts specialized programs in monetary policy, banking supervision, financial markets, foreign exchange, and economic research for central banking professionals. The Staff College also runs training programs for officers of other central banks in South and Southeast Asia as part of RBI's technical cooperation activities.

records.name: Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR)
records.description: Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR) Mumbai, established in 1987 and fully funded by the Reserve Bank of India, is a premier research university for development economics and related fields. It offers MSc, MPhil, and PhD programs in economics with strong emphasis on quantitative methods, monetary economics, environmental economics, and energy policy. IGIDR is consistently ranked among India's top economics research institutions and its faculty publish extensively in top international journals.

records.name: Institute of Economic Growth (IEG)
records.description: Institute of Economic Growth (IEG) New Delhi, established in 1958, is one of India's foremost centers for interdisciplinary research in economics, sociology, demography, and environmental studies. It is an autonomous institute under the University of Delhi and offers MPhil and PhD programs, attracting researchers focused on development economics, poverty, agriculture, and public policy. IEG has been associated with several eminent Indian economists and has contributed significantly to Indian economic policy research.

records.name: State Bank Institute of Learning and Development
records.description: State Bank Institute of Learning and Development (SBILD) Hyderabad is the apex training institution of State Bank of India, the country's largest public sector bank, providing professional training and development programs for SBI officers. It conducts specialized banking programs in credit management, foreign exchange, treasury operations, digital banking, and leadership development. SBILD plays a critical role in building the professional capabilities of SBI's large officer cadre to meet the evolving demands of the banking sector.

records.name: School of Planning and Architecture (SPA) Delhi
records.description: School of Planning and Architecture (SPA) Delhi, established in 1955 and recognized as an Institute of National Importance, is India's oldest and most prestigious institution for architecture and urban planning education. It offers BArch, BPlan, and postgraduate programs in urban design, housing, transportation planning, environmental planning, and urban management. SPA Delhi has shaped India's built environment through generations of architects and planners who have led major urban development projects across the country.

records.name: IIT Roorkee (Architecture)
records.description: IIT Roorkee is one of India's oldest and most prestigious technical institutions, established in 1847. Its Department of Architecture and Planning offers B.Arch, M.Arch, and Ph.D. programs with strong emphasis on sustainable design and urban planning. The department is consistently ranked among the top architecture programs in India.

records.name: Sir J.J. College of Architecture
records.description: Sir J.J. College of Architecture, affiliated with the University of Mumbai, is one of the oldest and most renowned architecture schools in India, founded in 1896. It offers a five-year B.Arch program with a rich heritage of producing influential architects and urban designers. The college is known for its strong focus on traditional and contemporary Indian architectural practice.

records.name: SPA Bhopal
records.description: School of Planning and Architecture Bhopal is one of the five national institutions of architecture established by the Government of India. It offers B.Arch, M.Arch, and M.Plan programs with a focus on sustainable architecture and regional planning. The institute draws students from across India and is known for its research-oriented faculty.
